summary: 成功率に加えてturn数・tool call数・token・時間・permission拒否/危険操作をrun単位で計測し、trajectory sampleを人が読む運用にする。

evidence.summary: tracked_metricsとしてn_turns, n_toolcalls, n_total_tokens, time_to_first_token, output_tokens_per_sec, time_to_last_tokenを併記、transcript読解を必須と明記。

events: `claude_code.tool_result`, `claude_code.tool_decision`, `claude_code.api_error`, `claude_code.permission_mode_changed`; metric `claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision`。`prompt.id`でprompt→events相関。tool詳細は既定で非記録（`OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS`でopt-in）。
trajectory監査でreward hacking・invalid passを実検出（evidence-supported, high）。
tool回数・cost・wall time・limit超過の監査とhard limit（operationally-supported）。

ai-development-improvement (org-private, reputation unknown): read references/evaluation-policy.md ("Evaluation unit" captures trajectory — commands, tool calls, skipped/required steps, time, tokens, retries — and efficiency), references/mode-audit.md (efficiency audits list repeated test/build runs, identical retries, repeated setup, redundant final verification, unnecessary subagents; "Use audit_trace.py for initial signals, then verify meaning against repository commands before recording a finding"), and scripts/audit_trace.py with references/audit-signals.json thresholds (repeated-full-test, identical-retry, repeated-read, subagent-fanout, context-compaction, token-volume).

applies_when: agentの採用判断・回帰監視・危険操作の検知
探索loopやtoken浪費が疑われる
not_applicable_when: telemetryを収集できないprivacy制約環境（→local eval時のみ計測）

expected_effect.primary: 成功率が同じでもcost・危険度・loopの差を可視化し、hard limitの根拠を得る

risks: 監査は事後で予防にならない
known_failure_modes: 監査logだけで危険操作を予防したつもりになる
revalidate_when: model update（tool利用傾向が変わる）

matched_on: per-run trajectory metrics beyond pass/fail: commands, tool calls, time, tokens, retries
threshold signals for repeated commands, repeated reads, subagent fan-out, compaction and token volume
a human must verify trace meaning against repository commands before a signal becomes a finding
